retrieval.topKHint: Top-k after the reranker. More context, slower answers.
retrieval.minScoreHint: Below this, a passage is dropped. This is what lets the app answer “not found”.
retrieval.rerankHint: Cost is linear here. Forty on a GPU, twenty on CPU.
retrieval.rrfHint: Small values trust rank one heavily; large values reward broad agreement.
retrieval.contextHint: Tokens of passages packed into the prompt.
retrieval.historyHint: Tokens of chat history before older turns are summarised.

performance.suggested: Suggested profile: {{profile}}. Overriding it is fine; it only changes defaults.
performance.profileHint: Sets candidate counts and batch sizes.
performance.batchHint: Passages embedded per call during indexing.
performance.layersHint: Layers offloaded to the GPU. 999 means all of them.
performance.parsersHint: Files parsed at once. Raise it on many cores.

storage.locationHint: Where the index, models and settings live.
storage.crashHint: Opt-in, and never includes document content.
storage.wipeHint: Deletes every source, document, passage and chat from the index. Files on disk are not touched, and downloaded models are kept.
storage.wipeBody: Every indexed document and every chat is removed and you will be taken back through setup. Your files and your connections stay.

welcome.title: A quick tour
welcome.body: Thirty seconds to show you around. Use the arrow keys, or Esc to skip.

chat.title: Chat
chat.body: Ask questions about your documents. Every answer cites the exact passage it comes from.

library.title: Library
library.body: Add folders and files here. Ibid indexes them locally; nothing leaves your computer.

convert.title: Slides to text
convert.body: Turn presentations into clean, readable text using your connected model.

models.title: Models
models.body: The local models that search and rank your documents. Download or swap them here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Connect a generative model, change the language, and fine-tune retrieval.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.body: If something looks off, start here: status of the core, the models and your hardware.

done.title: You're all set
done.body: Add a few documents to the Library, then ask your first question in Chat.

embedding.label: Embedder
embedding.blurb: Turns passages into vectors. Changing it forces a full re-index.

reranking.label: Reranker
reranking.blurb: Scores how well each candidate answers the question. Swappable at any time.

models.browseToInstall: Browse Hugging Face to install one.
models.reindexWarning_one: Switching the embedder makes every stored vector meaningless. The {{count}} document must be re-indexed before search works again.
models.reindexWarning_other: Switching the embedder makes every stored vector meaningless. All {{count}} documents must be re-indexed before search works again.
models.pickQuant: Pick a quantisation. Smaller files lose some quality; the fit badge is measured against this machine, as the {{role}}.
models.noGguf: This repository publishes no GGUF files, so it cannot run in llama.cpp.
models.searchHub: Search Hugging Face for {{role}} models in GGUF
models.recommendedHint: Known-good models whose smallest quantisation this machine can actually run.
models.noMatch: Nothing matched. GGUF is required, so repositories that only publish safetensors are filtered out.

welcome.title: A librarian for your own files
welcome.lead: Point it at folders you already have. It reads them, indexes them locally, and answers questions with the passage it used sitting next to the answer.
welcome.privateTitle: Your documents stay on this machine
welcome.privateBody: Parsing, embedding and search all run here. Only the question and the retrieved passages ever reach a model you choose — and that model can be a local one.
welcome.citedTitle: Every claim points at a page
welcome.citedBody: Answers carry citations. Click one and the reader opens on the exact span it came from, so a wrong answer is visibly wrong.
welcome.stepsBody: Check your hardware, get the two retrieval models, pick who writes the answers, add a folder.

hardware.title: Your machine
hardware.lead: Defaults come from what is actually here. Everything below is changeable later in Settings → Performance.
hardware.profileGpu: Plenty of VRAM. Models run on the GPU, batches are large, parsing runs wide.
hardware.profileBalanced: Enough memory to keep the retrieval models resident while you work.
hardware.profileCpu: No usable GPU found. Everything runs on CPU with small batches — slower, still correct.

models.title: The two models retrieval needs
models.lead: Both run locally and are small enough to stay resident. Downloads resume where they stopped and are checked against their sha256 before being used.
models.embeddingWhy: Turns every chunk and every question into a vector. Swapping it later means re-indexing.
models.rerankingWhy: Reads the question and each candidate together, then reorders them. This is what keeps answers on topic.

connection.title: Who writes the answers
connection.lead: Retrieval is local either way. This only decides which model turns the retrieved passages into prose.
connection.remoteWarning: The active connection is remote. Your question and the retrieved passages leave this machine when you ask something. Chat shows a banner whenever that is the case.

library.title: Point it at a folder
library.lead: Files are read in place — nothing is copied or moved. Start with one folder; add the rest from the Library whenever you like.

done.title: Set up
done.lead: Ask something in Chat. If an answer has no citation it says so rather than making one up — that is the whole point.
done.documentsBody: The Library shows every file, its status, and why anything failed.
done.citationBody: It opens the Reader on the page the passage came from, with the span highlighted.
done.diagnosticsBody: Process cards, the core's log tail and a debug report you can paste into an issue.

chat.composerHint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.
chat.groundingNone: No citations. Nothing in this answer is backed by a retrieved passage.
chat.groundingDropped_one: {{count}} citation pointed at a document that was not retrieved and was removed.
chat.groundingDropped_other: {{count}} citations pointed at documents that were not retrieved and were removed.
chat.groundingLow: Only one passage backs this answer. Treat it as weakly grounded.
chat.citationUnknown: {{docId}} was not among the retrieved passages
chat.remoteBanner: Retrieved passages leave this device: they are sent to {{name}}. Embedding and reranking stay local.
chat.emptyLead: Answers are built from passages in your library, and every claim links back to the page it came from.
chat.newProjectLead: Keep related chats together so they are easier to find and pin as a group.
chat.noChats: No chats yet. Ask something to start one.
chat.askToSeePassages: Ask a question to see the passages used in the answer.

suggestion.0: What does the document say about “{{topic}}”?
suggestion.2: What are the key points of “{{topic}}”?

suggestionModel.offer: Get better questions written by a small local model (1.1 GB download)

library.noSources: No folders yet. Add one to start indexing.

library.removeSourceBody_other: {{count}} documents and their passages are deleted from the index. The files on disk are not touched.

library.deleteFolderBody_other: Only the folder goes. Its {{count}} documents stay in the library and on disk.

converter.lead: Turns slides into a complete Markdown text, with web sources at the end. The result is saved in the global folder.
converter.noModelTitle: Connect a model to enable conversion
converter.noModelBody: Conversion uses the active generation model and stays disabled until a connection exists.
converter.emptyHint: Add a folder from the Library to make slides available.

converter.savedNote: Saved as a Markdown file in the global folder.

diagnostics.roleRagcore: Python core: ingestion, retrieval, the API every screen reads from.
diagnostics.roleEmbedding: Embedding server. Turns chunks and questions into vectors.
diagnostics.roleReranking: Cross-encoder. Reorders candidates before the prompt is packed.
diagnostics.unsupervised: Reported by the core, not supervised by the shell.
diagnostics.schema: Index schema v{{version}}. Changing the embedder rewrites every vector, so the schema version moves with it.
diagnostics.stub: The core is serving fixture data. Retrieval and answers are shaped like the real thing but are not computed over your documents.
diagnostics.reportNoSecrets: No API keys or session tokens are included.
diagnostics.restartingHint: The supervisor will bring it back.
diagnostics.lead: What is running, what it indexed, and what it printed
diagnostics.unreachable: The core is not answering on loopback. The process cards below still show what the shell knows, and the log tail is the fastest way to see why.
diagnostics.processesHint: Everything this app started on your machine.
diagnostics.environmentHint: Detected hardware and the build in use.
diagnostics.recentLogHint: Everything the app, the proxy and the core logged. The Logs page has the full view.

slowSpeed.text: Answers are slow on this computer (~{{speed}} tok/s). A cloud model would be faster.
